findingTitle: Published wallet is a CONTRACT, not a standard EOA wallet
findingDetail: The address on this agent's page has bytecode deployed. Most agent wallets are EOAs. If the agent claims this is its trading wallet, verify what the contract actually is and who controls it — publishing a token or protocol contract as 'the wallet' is a common disclosure miss.
note: Vette pulled the address published on BaseScout's own site and checked it against Base: bytecode present, contract verified as the AERO token contract. Verdict scored on real reads — every check in the public receipt.
